Fix off-by-one in page_slice page offset

page_slice treated pages as zero-based, so page 1 skipped the first
per_page items and the last page came back empty. Pages are one-based
everywhere else in the app, so subtract one before multiplying. The
change is in listing.py.

Refs: APP-9017

         raise ValueError("per_page must be positive")
-    start = page * per_page
+    start = (page - 1) * per_page
     return items[start:start + per_page]
